summary: Describes a mechanism that puts version numbers on EID-to-RLOC mappings and carries them in the LISP header of encapsulated packets. This gives in-packet information about the mappings used and helps detect when they are out of date. It obsoletes RFC 6834. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Each address book entry gets a version number written on the envelope. If it is older than the newest one, the receiver knows to go ask for the update.

questions: how does lisp detect stale mappings
